reason_not_taken: Still shaken by the losing trade twenty minutes earlier. I saw the setup and did not take it.
what_happened: Clean break of the London high, ran 62 points without a pullback into the close.
lesson_learned: The trade after a loss is the one I skip when it is good and force when it is bad. Exactly backwards.
next_time_plan: After a loss: no new entry for 15 minutes, then take the next A-grade setup at full plan size.

reason_not_taken: Waited for a retest the plan never asked for. I wanted a cheaper entry.
what_happened: Pushed 48 pips straight from the level, no retest.
lesson_learned: My plan says enter at the level. I was negotiating with it for a better price.
next_time_plan: Enter at the level, half size if unsure. Stop waiting for a retest that is not in the plan.

reason_not_taken: Daily loss limit already hit. Correct to skip.
what_happened: Setup worked, roughly 3R into the New York close.
lesson_learned: This one is a good miss. The rule did its job and it cost me nothing I should regret.
next_time_plan: Nothing to change. Logged so the good misses stay visible next to the bad ones.

reason_not_taken: Away from the desk. No alert set on the level I had marked the night before.
what_happened: Swept the Asian low and reversed for 1.9R.
lesson_learned: The level was in my plan. The alert was not.
next_time_plan: Every level written in the evening plan gets an alert before the session opens.

reason_not_taken: Graded the setup B because of the news window, then it turned out to be an A.
lesson_learned: I downgrade setups around news even when my own rules allow them. My grading drifts with my mood.
next_time_plan: Grade before the session, not in the moment. Do not regrade because of nerves.

reason_not_taken: Already three trades in on a day my plan caps at three. Correct to skip.
lesson_learned: The cap held. Missing a winner because of a rule is the price of the rule working.
next_time_plan: Keep the cap. Review it monthly on data, never in the middle of a session.
